text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning the blackboard on duty took way too much effort!
There was no need to write all the way up that high!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got a wee bit of a late start, but I gotta make it in time for today's specials!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Super Gekiyasu in the east, Umatoku Store in the west—
Wash your necks and wait for me~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, "Mega Cheap" is totally sold out!?
What about "Uma Bargain"—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way, over here too...!?
Our... Our bargain sale daaaayyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After running all over the place, Tamamo Cross couldn't buy what she was looking for and was left with nothing but fatigue.
